# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and ladylike young woman with a sweet voice. She has fair, curly hair, fascinating eyes, and dresses very beautifully, often wearing gowns with stylish, puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is an encouraging, tactful, and broad-minded teacher who wins the affection of her students and brings out their best qualities. She is innovative and enthusiastic, organizing nature field trips, recitations, physical culture exercises, and concerts. Though strict regarding deceit and wasted time, she is forgiving, helpful, and teaches her pupils to think independently and be their own severest critics.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P12](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0012), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher of Avonlea school. She introduced several new educational methods, including morning and evening physical culture exercises, bi-weekly recitation and dialogue afternoons, and field trips to the woods to study nature. She also organized a successful Christmas concert with her students in the Avonlea hall to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. When Anne Shirley was caught reading a storybook during class, Miss Stacy kept her in at recess to explain the error of deceiving her teacher, forgiving her freely when Anne repented. Later in the year, she organized an advanced class for students intending to take the Entrance examination for Queen's Academy, giving them extra lessons for an hour after school every day. Although offered a position in her home district's grade school for the following year, she chose to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their Entrance exams. She thoroughly drilled the Queen's class through their final year until they completed the term and successfully passed their Entrance examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- She was hired as the first female teacher in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- She was offered a teaching position in the grade school of her home district, but declined it to stay in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
